 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Viccissitude'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Vicissitude'.**
 
• The word '**Vicissitude**' is a **noun** which means 'a change of circumstances or fortune, typically one that is unwelcome or unpleasant'. **(परिवर्तन)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• He remained positive despite life’s vicissitudes.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'Viccissitude'.**

• **Idyllic -** extremely happy, peaceful, or picturesque **(सुखद और शांत)**
 
• **Ephemeral - **lasting for a very short time **(क्षणिक)**
 
• **Tenacious -** tending to keep a firm hold of something; persistent **(दृढ़)**
